title: Fixed relative smooth dimension descends under faithfully flat ring base change
statement: Fix $n\in\mathbb N$. For maps of commutative rings $R\to S$ and $R\to T$, with $R\to T$ faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map], suppose $T\to T\otimes_R S$ is locally standard smooth of relative dimension $n$: its spectrum has a covering by principal opens with standard smooth presentations [def-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-algebra] of dimension $n$. Then $R\to S$ is locally standard smooth of relative dimension $n$. Equivalently, this property codescends along faithfully flat maps.

source.place: Descent, Tag 02VL; Morphisms, Tag 02G1; Algebra, Tag 00T7 (2)

proof.text: Descend smoothness by the affine faithfully-flat smooth-descent theorem (Mathlib RingHom.Smooth.codescendsAlong_faithfullyFlat, the affine argument behind 02VL). Choose a standard smooth chart around each prime downstairs. Its differentials are free, with rank the dimension of the presentation.

Choose a prime upstairs over the given prime by faithful flatness. Differentials commute with tensor base change. The fibre of the differentials at the upstairs prime is scalar extension of the downstairs fibre, so its vector-space dimension is unchanged. The upstairs hypothesis says that dimension is n. Thus the standard smooth chart downstairs has presentation dimension n. The zero target ring is handled by the empty principal-open cover.
